mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher equity valuations due to reduced discount rates, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is continuous and active at all levels of the federal funds rate.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d forward returns is negative (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the time periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 0.3pp from prior month and PAYEMS > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE < 0.3pp from prior month and PAYEMS > 0.5% from prior month) is met in more than 60% of the time periods with negative 20d forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDP growth > 2.0% annualized and CPIAUCSL < 3.0% annualized), strong retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the time periods when the regime condition (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized and CPIAUCSL < 3.0% annualized) holds and RSAFS and HOUST are above their 75th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 60d forward returns is negative (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0, it signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the time periods when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an aggressive monetary policy response to economic stress, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 0.3% from prior month and FEDFUNDS < 0.05% from prior month
failure_condition: The joint condition (CPIAUCSL > 0.3% from prior month and FEDFUNDS < 0.05% from prior month) is met in more than 60% of the time periods with negative 20d forward returns.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000.0 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity that supports consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the time periods when HOUST > 1000.0.
